visual.title: Circulation to the left
visual.caption: The shear field pushes right where y is positive and left where y is negative. The loop integral does not vanish, and its sign is the sign of the scalar curl.

predict.question: For F = (y, 0), the scalar curl is:
predict.explain: curl F = ∂Q/∂x − ∂P/∂y = 0 − 1 = −1. The negative sign means the circulation runs clockwise on the drawn loop.
